notes: Zone scatter for procedural street detail. Coordinates are world metres: +X east, +Z south (the game's frame).
Zone shapes and scatter densities are production inference for the ferry-arrival pilot, not survey data.
Step 0 scatter emits placement slots only; later steps assign assets per slot kind. The runtime builds nothing from slots yet.

Furniture rules place the vertical street objects of the pilot zones (tools/lib/street-furniture-generation.mjs) where OSM leaves gaps: kerb (along the curbs of named kerbed roads), signalized_crossings and near_signals (at OSM crossings with signals), junctions (named-street corners), all_way_stops (the other approaches of an OSM stop=all junction), drive_entries (traffic turning into a kerbed service drive from a named road) and lot_edge (around a parking lot). Each is production inference with its dated photo evidence; prop is the kit prop the runtime builds and params its settings.

Exclusions are the shared mask for every street-detail source. The older vegetation clearances (roads 4 m, buildings 5 m, spawn 24 m, ferry path 16 m, QA route 7 m) size tree canopies; these values size walk, camera and doorway clearance instead. spawn_forward keeps the first walk clear: a corridor from the ferry spawn straight along its facing direction.

Furniture placement keeps its own site margins on top of this mask (tools/lib/street-furniture-generation.mjs): clear of the carriageway and curb ramps, and at least a player's width between two items.

Fence rules (tools/lib/street-fence-generation.mjs) draw photographed fencing OSM lacks as a line of legs: a way leg follows an OSM way at offset_m on one side (left or right of the way's own direction) between two along-distances (from_m above to_m walks it backwards); a point leg is a fixed [x, z]; consecutive legs join with straight runs. fence_type names a kit type (game/scripts/world/street_fence_kit.gd); params.inside is the side of the line the fenced site lies on, which fabric and screens face; a screened fence names its screen colour. A rule fence, like an OSM fence, opens wherever a road or path crosses it and where it meets the gameplay mask, and must stay off the raised street ground and the carriageway. Fences are placed before scatter and furniture, which keep clear of them.

Clutter rules place parked cars (tools/lib/street-clutter-generation.mjs): curb_parking packs cars along the curbs of a road's parking lanes, each side as stretches [from_m, to_m, fill] along the way (left and right of the way's own direction), with gap_m between cars (at least 1 m, so the player passes between them), clear of junctions and crosswalks by daylight_m, of fire hydrants by hydrant_m and of bus stops; lot_stalls fills a lot's painted stalls, fill_near beside the near_key building falling to fill_far beyond far_m, head_in of them nose first. mix and paints weight the body types and colours of the kit (tools/lib/street-clutter-kit.mjs); utility trucks are white. Each is production inference with its dated photo evidence. Photographed one-off clutter (cones, barricades) and the ferry plaza's furniture are set pieces (data/street_detail/set_pieces.json).

Vegetation: a scatter rule of a vegetation kind may plant a prop of the street-vegetation kit (tools/lib/street-vegetation-generation.mjs, game/scripts/world/street_vegetation_kit.gd), drawing a variant from params.variants and a uniform scale from params.scale; surfaces limits it to ground of those materials and within_xz to a polygon. Pattern along_beds walks the named ways at spacing_m and plants each station in the middle of the bed (ground of its surfaces) found across the way on each side between reach_m (metres from the way), when that bed is at least min_bed_m wide. Each planting rule is production inference with its dated photo evidence; photographed individual trees are set pieces (data/street_detail/set_pieces.json). Only species photographed on Treasure Island are planted; lawns stay a ground material.

Always-on street ground for the pilot zones: kerbs and raised sidewalks, curb ramps, road paint and asphalt wear, built by tools/lib/street-ground-generation.mjs into the chunk records. A zone without a ground block gets none.

Dimensions are production inference read from the dated pilot photos (Sep 2025 Treasure Island Road, ferry plaza and Building 1 forecourt; Sep and Nov 2025 Avenue of the Palms), not survey data. Road ribbons keep the frozen generator widths; parking lanes add asphalt beside them.

Collision: sidewalk tops are solid at the road surface plus reveal_m. The stock player has no step-up (floor_snap_length 0.35 m, floor_max_angle 48 degrees), so every curb face has an invisible collision ramp support_run_m wide in front of it, back edges a visible slope back_slope_run_m wide and curb-ramp sides a flare flare_run_m wide; the generator rejects any of them steeper than 40 degrees.
Wear densities are decals per 100 m2 of asphalt in the zone: low in the new district, more on older roads and the forecourt lot.

Sidewalks are poured concrete in panel_m squares that follow the street. closing_m fills gaps narrower than twice it between raised pieces. A zone with planting curb_strip turns the raised ground between the curb and a sidewalk set back by planting_gap_m or more, and the ground beyond the default sidewalk where an OSM sidewalk crowds the curb, into mulch beds (Avenue of the Palms, Sep 2025 photos ih02 and ih05). planting_behind_walk names OSM sidewalks photographed at the curb instead: the default walk stays there and the bed takes the ground behind it.
A plaza is a concrete walk walk_m wide at the curb plus banded paving out to depth_m, on the side of its roads nearest side_point_xz, clipped to its zone.

parking_lanes add width_m of asphalt beyond the frozen ribbon on both sides of the listed roads inside the zone; the curb, its ramps and the sidewalk move out with it (Avenue of the Palms: cars park along both curbs in Sep 2025 ih02 and ih05).
centerlines picks a style per road class: double_yellow, or dashed_faded (a worn yellow dash dash_m long every dash_m + dash_gap_m).

zones.name: Ferry arrival and Waterfront Plaza

plazas.reason: Sep 2025 photos 11-sv-road-sw and 13-sv-road-ne at 83 Treasure Island Rd: a wide concrete walk at the curb, then banded charcoal and grey paving out to the lawn

zones.reason: First view after the ferry spawn: the plaza lawn and paths between the landing pier and Treasure Island Road.
zones.reference: OSM w1428380754 (Waterfront Plaza, leisure=park), w1222514694 and w1036802527 (landing footways), ferry spawn from the manifest

furniture.rule: Charcoal plaza poles with small spot heads on curved brackets stand along the back edge of the Waterfront Plaza paving, about 24 m apart.
furniture.evidence: ferry-shelter 11-sv-road-sw and 13-sv-road-ne (83 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025), 15-sv-mar2025 and 17-sv-mar2025-canopy (Mar 2025), 21-sv-north-sw and 25-sv-north-mid (185 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025)

zones.reference: OSM w1249797944 and w1249797945 (Treasure Island Road), w1212173466 and w1212173452 (sidewalks)

furniture.rule: Galvanised bent-mast LED lamps stand on both curbs of Treasure Island Road, roughly opposite each other, about 34 m apart.
furniture.evidence: ferry-shelter 10-sv-road (83 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025), 20-sv-north and 23-sv-north-ssw (185 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025), 15-sv-mar2025 (Mar 2025)

furniture.rule: At each OSM signalized crossing, a galvanised mast-arm pole on the far side of the crosswalk for each direction, on the curb to the traffic's right: a signal head over the lanes, a head on the pole, a pedestrian head facing the crosswalk, a NO STOPPING ANY TIME sign and a street lamp on top.
furniture.evidence: OSM n9551738100 and n10206762980 crossing=traffic_signals; ferry-shelter 10-sv-road and 13-sv-road-ne (Sep 2025), 15-sv-mar2025 (Mar 2025), 18-sv-jan2023 (Jan 2023)

furniture.rule: Each signalized crossing has one very dark green-grey controller cabinet behind a far-side pole, on the landing with the most paved ground around it (the plaza side at the ferry crossing).
A post with green street-name blades (white text, OSM names) at one corner of every junction of named streets.
furniture.evidence: ferry-shelter 10-sv-road (Sep 2025): green name blade at the Trade Winds signal; isle-house ih15-cravath-nnw-context (55 Cravath St, Sep 2025): blades on a corner post

zones.name: Trade Winds Avenue to Avenue of the Palms link
zones.reason: The path from the Trade Winds turn to the north end of Avenue of the Palms.
zones.reference: OSM w255330044 (Trade Winds Avenue), w1248964744, w1530613464 and w1370667335 (cycleways)

furniture.rule: The Treasure Island Road lamps continue along Trade Winds Avenue, about 34 m apart, skipping a station where an OSM lamp already stands.
furniture.evidence: building1-references northwest-sep2025 (California Ave and Trade Winds Avenue, Sep 2025); OSM n11230312318 highway=street_lamp lamp_mount=bent_mast

fences.rule: The Cultural Park site around the Navy Chapel is a construction site behind 6 ft galvanised chain-link with a black windscreen (line posts about 10 ft apart, a top rail): along the Bruton Street sidewalk, the link path to Avenue of the Palms and the Trade Winds Avenue cycle path. Its Seven Seas Avenue side is not photographed and stays open. The printed sales banners and orange safety mesh on parts of it are left out.
fences.evidence: street-fences refs p8 (California Ave at Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025: the junction corner and the link path), p9 (51 California Ave, Sep 2025: the Trade Winds frontage), p5-s (5107 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: the Bruton frontage in front of the chapel); chapel-references sse-sep2025 and sse-detail-sep2025 (51 California Ave, Sep 2025); ferry-shelter 10-sv-road and 20-sv-north (Sep 2025: the black fence beyond the Trade Winds junction). A contributor pano dated Jun or Sep 2026 shows the screen taken off later.

zones.name: Avenue of the Palms

parking_lanes.reason: Sep 2025 photos ih02 and ih05: cars park along both curbs; the OSM sidewalks lie 6-9 m from the centre line, beyond the frozen 6 m ribbon

planting_behind_walk.reason: Nov 2025 photo palms-wsw01 at 999 Ave of the Palms: the walk runs at the curb and the mulch bed lies behind it, against the building

zones.reason: The palm-lined avenue named in the pilot route; palm slots stand behind both curbs (Sep 2025 ih02, ih05): in the east planting strip and beyond the narrow west sidewalk, clear of the parking lanes.
zones.reference: OSM w1001544697 (Avenue of the Palms), w1212173444 and w1375156123 (sidewalks)

scatter.rule: Young Mexican fan palms (Washingtonia robusta, a 4-7 m grey trunk under a small crown with a short brown skirt) stand in the mulch beds on the east side of Avenue of the Palms about 11 m apart: in the curb strip in front of Isle House and in the bed behind the walk along 490 Avenue of the Palms.
scatter.evidence: isle-house ih01 and ih02 (5286 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: palms in the curb strip in front of Isle House), ih05 (338 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025); large-batch1 palms-s-end03 (401 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025: two young palms in the bed behind the walk), palms-wsw01 (999 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025: the bed behind the walk)

scatter.rule: The west side's young fan palms stand just beyond the narrow west sidewalk along the park, about 13 m apart (within_xz keeps them north of the fenced Cityside Park lot, whose curb strip is sidewalk in the game).
scatter.evidence: street-fences refs p5 and p5-s (5107 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: a staked young palm by the west curb at the fenced lot), p4b (338 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025), p2 (Ave of the Palms mid, contributor 2026); large-batch1 palms-n-corner02 (801 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025: the west row receding south)

scatter.rule: The avenue's mulch beds are planted with clumping ornamental grasses, green and straw-coloured clumps about a metre across, set 1-2 m apart round the palms.
scatter.evidence: large-batch1 palms-wsw01 (999 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025) and palms-s-end03 (401 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025): straw and green clumps in the bed behind the walk; isle-house ih02 (Sep 2025): grasses in the curb strip; street-fences refs p4b and p5 (Sep 2025)

furniture.rule: Bent-mast LED lamps on both curbs of Avenue of the Palms, about 32 m apart, set between the palms of the planting strip.
furniture.evidence: isle-house ih01 and ih02 (5286 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025), ih05 (338 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025); large-batch1 palms-n-corner02 (801 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025); hawkins hk16 (55 Cravath St, Sep 2025)

furniture.rule: An OSM stop=all junction is an all-way stop: a stop sign with an ALL WAY plaque on the right-hand curb of every approach that OSM does not already sign, upstream of its crosswalk.
furniture.evidence: isle-house ih15-cravath-nnw-context (55 Cravath St, Sep 2025): stop signs with ALL WAY plaques at the Cravath Street junction; OSM n9244324886 and n9868733377 highway=stop stop=all

furniture.rule: A post with green street-name blades (white text, OSM names) at one corner of every junction of named streets.
furniture.evidence: isle-house ih15-cravath-nnw-context (55 Cravath St, Sep 2025): blades on a corner post at Cravath Street; ferry-shelter 10-sv-road (Sep 2025)

fences.rule: The unbuilt south end of Cityside Park, between Avenue of the Palms and the shore path, is a dirt lot fenced with galvanised temporary chain-link panels (6 x 12 ft tube frames clamped at the joints): along the back of the south-west sidewalk from 338 Ave of the Palms to the avenue's south end, and from the corner at 338 toward the shore path. The finished park to the north-west is open.
fences.evidence: street-fences refs p4b (338 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025, h228: the corner and the leg toward the shore), p5 and p5-s (5107 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: the panels behind the sidewalk), isle-house ih05 (Sep 2025: the panels along the avenue), p10 (5286 Ave of the Palms, Jun 2026: the panels still standing), p2 and p3 (2026: no fence on the finished park to the north-west). The OSM Cityside Park polygon leaves this lot out.

clutter.rule: Cars park nose to tail along the east curb of Avenue of the Palms for its whole length and along the west curb north of the Cityside Park lot; the west curb beside the fenced lot is empty. Mostly compact SUVs, sedans and an EV fastback or two, some hatchbacks and wagons, few pickups; mostly white, silver and grey, some black and dark grey, the odd blue or red. The curb stays clear 20 ft (6.1 m) either side of crosswalks and junctions and 15 ft (4.6 m) either side of fire hydrants (California Vehicle Code 22514).
clutter.evidence: isle-house ih01, ih02 (5286 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: the east curb lined with cars), ih05, ih06 (338 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: the east curb parked, the west curb empty beside the fenced lot), ih18 (5107 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025); large-batch1 palms-s-end03 (401 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025: a sedan and an SUV on the east curb), palms-n-corner02 (801 Ave of the Palms, Nov 2025: cars along the west curb at the north end); street-fences p5-aotp-south-s (5107 Ave of the Palms, Sep 2025: the west curb empty at the south end)

furniture.evidence: building1-references southwest-sep2025 (17 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025): a red stop sign facing Treasure Island Road at the end of the planted island by the forecourt drive's crosswalk

furniture.rule: Slim grey poles with small post-top lanterns stand just outside the edge of the Building 1 forecourt lot, about 24 m apart.
furniture.evidence: building1-references public-wsw-sep2025 (1 Avenue of the Palms, Sep 2025): a slim grey pole with a post-top lantern in the bed at the lot's Treasure Island Road edge; southwest-sep2025 (Sep 2025): slim grey poles across the lot

clutter.rule: The Building 1 forecourt lot is full along the building and in the half-moon rows near it, thinning out toward Treasure Island Road, where most stalls stand empty; mostly nose first. White utility pickups with service bodies park among sedans and SUVs; mostly white, silver and grey, some black, the odd blue or red.
clutter.evidence: building1-references southwest-sep2025 (17 Treasure Island Rd, Sep 2025: the rows by the building full, white utility pickups, sedans and SUVs), public-wsw-sep2025 (1 Avenue of the Palms, Sep 2025: the stalls near the road mostly empty, cars along the building)

notes: Scored-building sides a built fence closes (north, south, west or east, as the building fit names them). The fit skips such a side only when every start it tries there is blocked by the listed fence rows, another building or the island's edge, and prints the fence; a fence that closes a side without being listed here fails the fit. List a side only with dated evidence that the fence is real and closes it.
